args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate (~18%) since the latest deploy. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release known to be healthy in production. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%. Follow-up needed: root-cause analysis of the v2.3.1 failure.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failure — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: All production regions were rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was previously healthy in production (v2.3.0 had a healthy status in deploy history; v2.3.1 was the first unhealthy release).
3. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback, the service reports healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** titled "checkout-api v2.3.1 failure — rolled back to v2.3.0" was created, the on-call engineer has been paged, and it includes a full account of what was done plus a note that root-cause analysis of v2.3.1 is needed.
